column1: # ACTION JU (p173), FALSIFIER LIMB 2: "refuted if the fix breaks any existing test in
# lib/test_license_family.sh". Taken wider than the limb asked: EVERY test in this repository that
# sources the shared classifier -- 14 suites across 14 instruments, found by
# `grep -rl license_family.sh --include=test_*`. 42 non-test instruments also source it.
# pristine = compose/code with lib/license_family.sh restored from HEAD (git show), run in a COPY.
# patched  = the working tree. Each suite run from its OWN directory.
# RESULT: 13 of 14 byte-identical. The 1 difference is p355-cwd-portability, which fails in the
# COPY and passes in the real tree both before and after -- a location artefact of the copy, and
# T250: the control that exists to prove cwd-portability is itself not location-portable.
